purpose: Continue the full-registry affiliate-program audit for another five registered tools. This is research-only evidence under the existing audit UUID; no application or duplicate task was created.

entries.eligibility: Current official pages confirm an affiliate/partner program with recurring commissions for 12 months per active referred customer.
entries.evidence_summary: Panda Video clearly operates Panda Partners, but current official materials conflict on the rate/tier structure. The current Brazilian program page says signup begins at 10% and can scale to 20%, while the official help article describes Premium at 20% and Super Premium at 30% for 12 months. Because the authoritative rate applicable to a new COSHUMA account is not unambiguous, the program is kept at needs_manual_verification rather than recording a guessed commission.

entries.commission: 25% recurring on referred subscriptions while referred customers remain subscribed, according to LoopCV's current July 10, 2026 official company blog and affiliate materials
entries.eligibility: Official affiliate page is aimed at blogs and companies serving job seekers and provides registration, email verification and a unique referral-link dashboard.
entries.evidence_summary: LoopCV's official affiliate page confirms an active affiliate registration flow and affiliate dashboard; LoopCV's official July 10, 2026 article states a 25% recurring commission. Cookie duration and public payout threshold/method were not established from the official sources retrieved and remain unknown.

entries.commission: Choice of $178 one-time commission per qualifying paying customer or 20% recurring commission during the first 12 months; official page says affiliates may join one or both structures
entries.payout_terms: Monthly via PayPal; current offer page states a $20 payout threshold and a two-month hold for the $178 fixed offer
entries.eligibility: No Tapfiliate customer subscription is required. Official page targets e-commerce entrepreneurs, social influencers, complementary businesses, professional marketers and content creators.
entries.evidence_summary: Tapfiliate's current official affiliate page confirms two active commission structures, a 45-day cookie and monthly PayPal payouts. Its signup form has a required Terms and Conditions agreement, so no signup was performed in this research-only audit.

entries.commission: 20% of all referred-customer payments for 12 months, for monthly or yearly plans
entries.payout_terms: Automatic payouts; public affiliate page does not state the current payout threshold or exact payout method
entries.eligibility: Kittl's current partner hub says the affiliate path is for anyone who creates online content on social media, blogs or websites; applications are reviewed weekly and an answer is normally expected within five days.
entries.evidence_summary: Kittl's current official affiliate page confirms an active Impact Radius affiliate program, a unique link after approval, and 20% commission on all payments for the first 12 months. Cookie and payout-threshold values were not stated in the official public material retrieved, so they remain unknown.

entries.commission: 30% lifetime recurring commission on all sales
entries.payout_terms: $50 minimum payout; commissions become payable after 30 days; payouts run in the first week of each month; official support says payments are sent through Wise to an email/bank account
entries.eligibility: Applicants email Koala AI with audience details and relevant website/YouTube/social links. Paid advertising, self-referrals, deceptive promotion and coupon/thin sites are prohibited.
entries.evidence_summary: Koala AI's current official affiliate page confirms 30% lifetime recurring commission, a 60-day cookie, $50 minimum payout and direct application by email. No application email was sent because this task is the research-only full audit, not the later application batch.

dedupe_notes: All five results are attached to the existing audit UUID; no new queue UUID was generated.
No affiliate signup, terms acceptance, account creation, email application, payment or production write was performed.
Where official sources conflict, the conflict is preserved and the status is needs_manual_verification instead of fabricating a single value.
